full_text:
Camoforge is an illusory spell used by members of the Huntik Foundation that allows a Seeker to turn invisible. It is similar to Hidesight, which can turn Titans or objects invisible.

== History ==
This spell was used by Den Fears on the longest night of the year so that he avoid detection as he searched for his brother, Harrison, at the Blood Spiral Base. Sandra Lambert also used the spell to stowaway on a Scramjet and help Scarlet Byrne. [The Spiral Mark]

==Trivia==
* Zhalia Moon has used the power Thoughtspecter in a similar fashion, in "The Vampire Loses Its Fangs and "Zhalia's Mission", both times when leaving the Huntik team.
